name: UN WPP 2024 Medium fertility
description: Opt-in demographic overlay: regional fertility follows the UN World Population Prospects 2024 Medium variant (2025 TFR and its 2025-2100 path, fit in the model's floor/convergence form) and life expectancy rises 0.16 yr/yr (WPP Medium world e0 73.3 in 2024 -> 77.4 in 2050), instead of the default Fernandez-Villaverde & Norrick (2026) path. Use it to compare against or calibrate to forecasts that assume UN Medium (IMF, OECD, CBO-style long-run projections); it is not the model's view. Lands within 1-3% of WPP Medium world population (9.53B in 2050 vs 9.66B; 9.90B in 2100 vs 10.18B): the remaining gap is the model's stylized working-age mortality and migration.

meta.source: UN WPP 2024 Demographic Indicators (Medium), aggregated by scripts/wpp-fertility-paths.py; fit rmse <= 0.01 births/woman
